method: Separate agents used isolated fixtures and reported their observations; no real novel modified.

checks: Strict and local history publication update chapter title and volume directory, preserve previous prose, and rebind dependent chapter SHA.
Reconcile of an externally edited history-published latest chapter requires a history branch without mutation; that branch can publish and retain the external draft.

Interrupted renamed export, external edit of the old path, safe export, and later reuse of the old filename preserve external and intermediate drafts; retirement records clear and old SHAs remain readable.
12 invalid amount or endpoint cases reject atomically.
4 cross-tick transfer combinations preserve holder balances and transfer direction.
4 unknown-date and clock controls keep uncertain balances unverified and other clocks isolated.
Minimum supported negative tick opening and spending retain the overdraft blocker.
